subject: Pipeline tidy-up: ownership confirmations & close-date sanity check
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Pipeline tidy-up: ownership confirmations & close-date sanity check

Team —

We need a quick hygiene run across the Q4 committed pipeline. Finance asked for a sanity-checked list of the top 60 deals by ARR for tomorrow’s forecasting sync (Friday 11/13). I exported a starting set (attached q4_top60_deals.csv) — please do the following by EOD today:

- Owners: confirm you are the active AE/owner in SFDC and that no other rep owns the record.
- Stage: verify the SFDC stage reflects the current customer commitment (Proposal/Negotiation vs. Closed Won/Plan to sign).
- Close date: update to the vendor-committed close date where there is a firm PO/PO intent; otherwise set to the best-estimate and add a note.
- Flags: tag any deal >$250k that is at risk and add a 1-line rationale in the comments.

If you don't own a row in the CSV, reassign the Owner column in SFDC and ping me with the new owner. We need the cleansed list uploaded back to the Drive folder linked below for the finance team.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/abc123
HubSpot ref: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/2384

Attachments: q4_top60_deals.csv (csv)

Thanks — short and tactical here.

David
David Kim
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pipeline tidy-up: ownership confirmations & close-date sanity check

David —

Got it. I’ll run the list against SFDC ownership and push an ownership correction for any duplicates. Quick question on scope: the CSV includes a few renewal-style deals that are managed by CS — do you want those included in the top 60 cleanup or should I exclude renewals where ARR delta is < $50k?

I’ll start on this now and aim to have ownerships reconciled by 3pm PT.

— Priyom

Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 13:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pipeline tidy-up: ownership confirmations & close-date sanity check

Adding the external thread here so procurement visibility is maintained. 

Cathy — looping you in because MedTech appears on the top-60 extract (Deal RDW-2384). Our finance team is doing a close-date sanity check for forecasting. Quick context: customer has signaled intent and we have an initial SOW, but procurement has an internal review window. Can you confirm if there’s an expected PO issuance date or if procurement needs a revised SOW to move forward? I’ve attached the current SOW draft attached.

We’d appreciate a short ETA — if PO issuance is >3 weeks out please flag so we can move the deal to "At Risk" for forecasting purposes.

Attachments: MedTech_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pipeline tidy-up: ownership confirmations & close-date sanity check

Laura / David —

Thanks for the heads up and for attaching the SOW. Procurement has the draft and we have an internal milestone: procurement review completes on 11/24, legal review the week of 11/29. Realistically PO issuance is likely around the first week of December (target ~12/03) unless we get a prioritized review. If you can provide a clean SOW with pricing summary at the top (one-pager) I can try to accelerate.

If you mark the deal as "At Risk" for the finance sync that will reflect our current timeline. Otherwise please note "Commit estimate: 2026-12-03 (subject to legal)" in the Close Date comment.

Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Cathy Lopez
Senior Procurement Manager
MedTech Solutions

Appreciate the quick responses and the clarity, Cathy.

Plan: Priyom will finish ownership and stage corrections this afternoon. Laura — thanks for the outreach and the SOW; if you can drop a 1-page pricing summary in the Drive folder by EOD today that will be the best way to try to accelerate procurement.

Action items (summary):
- Priyom: reconcile owners + update Stage/Close Date comments in SFDC (by 3pm PT today).
- Laura: upload 1-pager SOW + pricing summary to Drive (by EOD today).
- David: consolidate updated CSV and push to finance in the Drive; mark deals with PO timeline >3 weeks as "At Risk" for the sync.

I'll update the HubSpot deal RDW-2384 and add the PO ETA note from Cathy. Final cleaned list will be uploaded to Drive and I’ll ping Forecast@Finance when ready.

Thanks team — small, visible lift and then we can run the forecast with higher confidence.

David
David Kim
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
